mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, permissions, sort FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT id, code, name, permissions, sort FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.permissions, r.sort, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.role_id = r.id) AS user_count FROM sys_role r ORDER BY r.sort, r.id
